title: Ayyanar Thunai
description: Chandayatha welcomes Karthika inside as she passes by Cheran's home. She deliberately makes Karthika taste a hot sweet, hurting her mouth and leaving her in pain.

title: Azhagae Azhagu
description: Revathy, Malar and Mathi talk about the issues at Malar's in-laws' home. They advise Malar to wait until her in-laws realise her worth and invite her back.

title: Bigg Boss
description: Munniyammal is jailed for the theft while Vasan secretly secures the hidden diamond. Investigators fail after three rounds. Both teams then face off in the Democracy Assembly.

title: Chinna Marumagal
description: Dr. Kalpana includes Tamizhselvi in researching the eye camp medicine for court evidence. Meanwhile, vigilance officers find ₹20 lakh in Rajangam's outhouse, shocking him.

title: Kadhal Kadhal Kadhal
description: Kasthuri feels grateful to Karthik for supporting her despite his family's opposition. Shyam deliberately assigns Arjun menial work during an office meeting to provoke him.

title: Kanmani Anbudan
description: Furious over the attack, Rajeshwari blames Kanmani for her feud with the goons. Soon, a legal notice from Vennila's mother demanding repayment leaves Rajeshwari stunned.

title: Onna Irukka Kaththukanum
description: Kandhasamy offers Indhira a steady salary to quit her bike taxi job. Inspired by her, Sarasu seeks financial independence, but Kumaran opposes her decision.

title: Pandian Stores 2
description: Saravanan's care for Thangamayil rekindles hopes of reunion as the family welcomes the baby. Meanwhile, Meena remains adamant despite Senthil's insistence on having a child.

title: Siragadikka Aasai
description: Ragu schemes to ruin Muthu's business by luring his drivers with better pay and incentives. Elsewhere, Muthu is delighted by Vijaya's newfound care for him and Meena.

title: Suttum Vizhi Sudare
description: Sudar asks Vetri to live with her and Abinaya, but he refuses to avoid angering Abinaya further. Prabhakaran accidentally reveals his love for Divya before Swetha and Sivashankari.

title: Thaai Maaman
description: Despite Pechi's counsel to embrace the affection of Mayandi's family, Poongodi remains bent on revenge. Later, Pechi expresses gratitude to Azhagar for supporting Poongodi.

title: Thendrale Mella Pesu
episodeTitle: Paraman, Ilamathi are on Cloud Nine
description: Paraman gets closer to Ilamathi during their wedding night, creating tender moments. Meanwhile, Kalamma and Ranjitham hatch a plan to ruin their special night.
